## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Email, subject "A new green tea", to Tom (UK customer list), timing not specified.

**Checks**
- **Claims:** No statistics, rankings, testimonials, guarantees or comparisons. The sencha description (grassy, a little sweet, brewed around 70 degrees) and "added to the shop" are product facts and new arrivals, which the policy allows as written. Pass.
- **Regulated claims:** No health, money, legal, environmental, children or price content. "Green tea" is the tea type, not an environmental claim. Pass.
- **House style:** The copy is short, plain and specific. It has no stock openers, empty intensifiers, slogan closers or other AI tells. Pass. The policy doesn't define voice words, so I judged this on clarity and absence of tells only.
- **Disclosure:** This is the brand's own email about its own product. It has no sponsorship, affiliate links, gifted products or AI-generated imagery, so no label is needed. Pass.

**Fixed:** Nothing needed changing.

**Needs a decision:** Nothing is unresolved. Check that the send is to people who have opted in to marketing email, which this review can't verify.

**Approver:** The policy doesn't name one, so I need an explicit yes from you for this exact text before it is sent or scheduled. I haven't recorded any approval.
